title: Five-Storied Pagoda of Tō-ji
summary: The five-storied pagoda of Tō-ji in Kyoto is about 55 m tall and is described as the highest pagoda in Japan. The present pagoda was built in 1644 with support from the third Tokugawa shogun, Iemitsu. The first on the site dates to the 9th century, and its successors burned down four times.

uncertainty.note: 1644 is the present pagoda (Tō-ji, MLIT, World History Encyclopedia). Tō-ji says the first was built in the 9th century; World History Encyclopedia gives 826 for that first pagoda. End is the present.
